description: This Java class 'InboxMainActivity' extends Android's Activity class, responsible for managing the inbox view in a wearable notifications app. It primarily handles the cancellation of notifications upon creation and includes a placeholder comment for future email handling logic.

classes.name: InboxMainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for handling the inbox view in a wearable notification app, responsible for canceling notifications when created.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and cancels an existing notification identified by MainActivity.NOTIFICATION_ID.
